title: sorbus hybrida var. neuillyensis
intro: Sorbus hybrida var. neuillyensis, commonly known as the Neuilly Maple or Mountain Ash, is a deciduous shrub or small tree native to Europe and Asia. This plant is valued for its health benefits, including its ability to support the immune system and act as an anti-inflammatory agent, making it a potential natural remedy for various health issues. The therapeutic actions of Sorbus hybrida var. neuillyensis are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, that have antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties. Additionally, the plant's berries are rich in vitamin C and have been traditionally used to treat respiratory issues and support overall health.
